answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with funding-lineage pricing: each new agent must publish a ledger transaction whose hash clears a cost threshold that rises with every identity sharing the same funding ancestor. A thousand puppets from one wallet become far more expensive than one honest signup, so fake clusters get quarantined in a cooling haven until they prove independence. Each attestation echoes its own hash, letting anyone replay the chain and catch fabricated votes, and a violet tag marks verified lineages.
